cases.name: wfh_laundry_lift_groceries
cases.prompt: Plan my work-from-home day from 08:00 to 21:00. I work 09:00-17:00. I have standup 10:00-10:30, planning 13:00-13:30, and a client call 15:30-16:00. Wash clothes for 30 minutes starting at 08:00, transfer them for 5 minutes within 15 minutes after washing, then dry them for 45 minutes immediately after the transfer. Lift for 60 minutes and get groceries for 45 minutes; both are required, and groceries must finish by 20:30. I would like lifting finished by 16:00, priority 5, and prefer to minimize work interruptions, priority 3.

cases.name: active_and_passive
cases.prompt: Schedule 09:00-12:00. There is a meeting from 09:00-10:00. Start the dishwasher at 09:00; it runs passively for 90 minutes. I need a 30-minute active phone call after 10:30.

cases.name: laundry_precedence
cases.prompt: Use an 08:00-14:00 horizon. Laundry has three required steps: wash is passive for 30 minutes, transfer is active for 5 minutes, and dry is passive for 45 minutes. Transfer must happen after washing and within 10 minutes of its finish; drying starts immediately after transfer.

cases.name: hard_timing
cases.prompt: The available day is 08:00-18:00. I must do a required 45-minute active workout no earlier than 16:00 and it must finish no later than 18:00. I also need a required 20-minute active shower after the workout.

cases.name: soft_finish_preference
cases.prompt: Plan a 09:00-17:00 day with a required 60-minute active report. I would ideally like the report finished by 15:00, but that is only a preference.

cases.name: workout_before_four_soft
cases.prompt: Plan my day from 09:00 to 18:00. I have a required 60-minute active workout. I'd really like to work out before four, but it's okay if I can't.

cases.name: workout_before_four_hard
cases.prompt: Plan my day from 09:00 to 18:00. I have a required 60-minute active workout. I absolutely have to finish my workout before four.

cases.name: optional_walk_if_time
cases.prompt: Plan 09:00 to 17:00. I must complete a 90-minute active report. A 30-minute active walk would be lovely if there is room, but it is not essential today.

cases.name: impossible_hard_workout_window
cases.prompt: My available day is 15:30 to 16:00. I absolutely must complete a required 60-minute active workout and it has to finish by 16:00.

cases.name: straightforward_staffing
cases.prompt: Staff two shifts on 2026-10-05. Shift front_morning runs 09:00-13:00 at front_desk and needs one employee. Shift back_evening runs 14:00-18:00 at backroom and needs one employee. Alice can work up to 8 hours and is eligible for front_desk and backroom. Bob can work up to 4 hours, is eligible for front_desk, and is unavailable from 09:00 to 13:00 on 2026-10-05. The minimum rest rule is 0 hours.

cases.name: preferences_and_availability
cases.prompt: For 2026-10-06, staff shift s1 from 09:00 to 13:00 at the clinic and shift s2 from 14:00 to 18:00 at the clinic; each needs one person. Alex can work 8 hours at the clinic and prefers s1. Blair can work 8 hours at the clinic, prefers s2, and is unavailable for s1. Use a minimum rest rule of 0 hours.

cases.name: infeasible_staffing_is_extracted_not_repaired
cases.prompt: Front desk 09:00-13:00 requires 2; front desk 13:00-17:00 requires 2; back room 09:00-13:00 requires 1; back room 13:00-17:00 requires 1. Alice and Bob are front-desk-only and can each work up to 4 hours. Carla is back-room-only, can work up to 4 hours, and is unavailable 09:00-13:00. There are no other employees.
